contentItem.title: 圆锥：直角三角形绕一条直角边旋转形成
contentItem.englishTitle: When, one side of those about the right angle in a right-angled triangle remaining fixed, the triangle is carried round and restored again to the same position from which it began to be moved, the figure so comprehended is a cone. And, if the straight line which remains fixed be equal to the remaining side about the right angle which is carried round, the cone will be right-angled; if less, obtuse-angled; and if greater, acute-angled.

surfaces.text: When, one side of those about the right angle in a right-angled triangle remaining fixed, the triangle is carried round and restored again to the same position from which it began to be moved, the figure so comprehended is a cone. And, if the straight line which remains fixed be equal to the remaining side about the right angle which is carried round, the cone will be right-angled; if less, obtuse-angled; and if greater, acute-angled.
当直角的一方在直角三角形上固定时,三角形被绕过,并恢复到开始移动的同一位置,数字被如此理解为一个锥形。如果仍然固定的直线等于圆圆直角的其余一边,则锥形将被右勾勒;如果小,则模糊缠绕;如果更大,则尖形缠绕。
